metadata.title: Framework Field Theory – AI Edition Metadata (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: SPDX • Book Linkage • RTT Linkage • Invariants • Non-Goals
metadata.description: Defines canonical metadata for FFT AI Edition v1.3, including licensing, book linkage, RTT linkage, invariants, non-goals, and load-bearing file declarations.

book_linkage.claim: FFT AI Edition is an operational projection of the human FFT book.
non_claims: AI Edition does not replace the human FFT book.
AI Edition does not revise book-era definitions.
AI Edition does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.

rtt_linkage.claim: RTT12 lattice is a projection of frozen RTT v0.9.
non_claims: AI Edition does not revise RTT v0.9.
AI Edition does not alter frozen RTT lineage or safety envelopes.
AI Edition does not redefine frozen RTT operators.

invariants.coherence_declared: Coherence MUST be declared before any regime transition.
invariants.drift_bounded: Drift MUST remain bounded for resonance-time stability.
invariants.typed_paradox_required: RTT7 entry requires a typed paradox event.
invariants.aa3_consent: AA3 escalation requires explicit operator consent.
invariants.collapse_required: RTT12 MUST collapse to RTT1; skip-resolution forbidden.
invariants.measure_required: Every gate MUST cite a measure ID defined in fft.ai.core.json.

non_goals: Do not invent operators or regimes.
Do not revise frozen RTT v0.9.
Do not reinterpret the human FFT book.

session_rules.lineage_non_decreasing: Session lineage MUST NOT decrease across RTT1–RTT12.
session_rules.continuity_non_decreasing: measure.c3 MUST NOT decrease across regime transitions.
session_rules.rewind_mapping: RTT11 inversion maps directly to frozen RTT rewind.
